Altcoins fared worse: ether slid toward $2,400, while CoinDesk's DeFi index sank 5.6%. Read full story 💰 Bitcoin ETFs Pull $528M in Biggest Day in a Month U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs took in $528.4 million on Wednesday, their strongest single session in almost a month, with BlackRock's IBIT and Fidelity's FBTC accounting for roughly 85% of the total and lifting the week's tally above $1 billion. Spot ether ETFs also turned positive, ending a five-day run of withdrawals, as investors position ahead of the Oct. 28 Fed decision and the Nov. 3 U.S. midterms. More details 🏦 OCC Finalizes GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rule, Banks Cry Foul The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency published its final rule implementing the GENIUS Act, keeping the ban on issuer-paid yield but dropping a proposed presumption against rewards offered through exchanges and other third parties in favor of case-by-case review. The American Bankers Association warned the change effectively leaves crypto platforms' rewards programs intact, while the Blockchain Association said the rule now tracks the statute more closely. The framework takes effect Jan. 18, 2027.
